findings.label: No Expo config plugin added
findings.detail: The written requirement called for an app.json config plugin entry, but react-native-bluetooth-classic@1.73.0-rc.17 ships no app.plugin.js. The coder wired Android permissions via the explicit android.permissions array and documented the deviation in the commit. The native build (not run per task) must confirm autolinking produces a working manifest.

findings.label: Pinned RC dependency
findings.detail: react-native-bluetooth-classic is pinned to 1.73.0-rc.17, a release candidate, because the library publishes only RC builds. Acceptable per the plan's documented fallback; re-pin to a stable release when one ships.
